description: This file defines a service class OpenAIChatService for communicating with the OpenAI Chat Completion API, including error handling via ChatGPTError and ChatGPTException classes. It manages sending messages and parsing responses from the API.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible errors from the OpenAI API.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Exception class that wraps ChatGPTError, providing a human-readable message.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling communication with the OpenAI Chat API, including sending messages and processing responses.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a list of ChatMessage instances to the OpenAI API and returns the assistant's reply as a String.
